dataset: NYC TLC yellow taxi trip records, January through March 2019
selection: All physical rows in three original TLC Parquet files. Retained columns are listed in imported_schema; no synthetic fact rows were generated and no anomalous rows were dropped.
imported_schema:
trip_id: int64 not null
source_month: int32 not null
source_row: int32 not null
pickup_unix_us: int64
pickup_zone_id: int32
dropoff_zone_id: int32
passenger_count: double
trip_distance: double
total_amount: double
fare_cents: int64

derived_fields.trip_id: (source_month - 201900) * 100000000 + zero-based physical Parquet row ordinal; unique only within this explicitly selected three-month fixture
derived_fields.source_month: Original source file month as YYYYMM, irrespective of anomalous timestamps in its records
derived_fields.source_row: Zero-based physical Parquet row ordinal within the original monthly file
derived_fields.pickup_unix_us: Original microsecond timestamp represented as signed Int64, preserving nulls
derived_fields.fare_cents: Round original Float64 total_amount * 100 to nearest integer with half-to-even rounding, then safe cast Int64; null/non-finite original amounts become null. The original Float64 total_amount is retained unchanged. This is a derived metric, not a claim of exact original monetary decimal precision.

large_join_projection.selection: First 1000000 physical rows of the January file, projected to trip_id,pickup_zone_id,fare_cents
